Great Food in Saigon.
Sep 2026 • Friends
The restaurant is ideally situated for everyone to easily find. The food was to die for, particularly the heo toc quay lu chat met. Finally, the staff was extremely attentive and continued to check on us, throughout our wonderful gathering, on the first day of Ho Chi Minh City. I highly recommend this fine restaurant.
Written September 20, 2026

Thank you so much for your 5-star review and your kind words!

Your appreciation is a great motivation for our team. We look forward to welcoming you back for another excellent dining experience!
